summary: Martin County steel lookout near Shoals/Lacy; build dates conflict (1931-1937); 1967 survey says no longer in use; no source describes remains.

facts.status_note: Listed gone by firelookout.org; a 1967 survey update says the tower was no longer in use.
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Hoosier National Forest (land)

visit.trail_note: The author's 2023 drive south of Lacy on Windom Road ended at a gravel loop; the tower spot was not pinned down.

events.note: Newspaper item on a district forester overseeing a tower's erection at Shoals; may concern the nearby Willow Valley tower.
Forest Service history: plan approved July 30, 1937, for a 100-foot steel tower with a dwelling, garage, latrine and cistern.
Survey describes a 108-foot four-leg steel lookout tower on Forest Service land, with a rangers house nearby.
Survey update: ranger house removed and the lookout tower no longer in use.

corrections.why: 2N is part of the legal location (T2N, R3W, Sec 7), not an agency. The 1946 survey places the tower on Forest Service property, and the Shoals page lists Hoosier National Forest.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: A 1931 item, a 1937 plan approval and a 1946 survey do not agree on when a tower stood here. The 1931 item may concern the nearby Willow Valley tower, which some sources date to 1931 and others to 1933. No build year is recorded.
The 1937 Forest Service plan calls for 100 feet; the 1946 survey describes 108 feet. No height is recorded.
The Forest Service list says Lacy, near Shoals; the Indiana guide keeps Shoals because old topo maps and survey records use it.

notes_for_editor: Build date and height are unresolved, so neither is recorded as a fact. The 1931 item may describe Willow Valley rather than this site. Living New Deal pages returned 403 and were not read; a search snippet titled Martin State Forest Fire Tower - Shoals IN gives 1933 completion, possibly about Willow Valley. The Indiana guide's 'South of Lacy' location and the NGS 'three miles south-southeast of Shoals' differ in reference point, not in substance.
